Section 4(b) (p. 2): Pao 'appears on the Ethnologue map.. as an unlikely Tibeto-Burman island'; Ethnologue reports the Pao Scheduled Tribe is 'reported to speak Bagheli [bfy] as L1' (Singh 1994), Singh 1997 says Bundeli [bns]; Hammarström (2015) suggests confusion with Pa'O [blk] of Myanmar; 'the code [ppa] should be deprecated'.

sources.note: Nothing on stress. 'Population 53,000 (2000). Location Madhya Pradesh, Satna, Chhatarpur, Datia, Panna, Rewa, Shahdol, Sidhi, and Tikamgarh districts.. Classification Sino-Tibetan, Tibeto-Burman, Unclassified.. May not be Tibeto-Burman.. A Scheduled Tribe. Reported to speak Bagheli [bfy] as L1 (Singh 1994).'
Nothing on stress; no mention of Pao/[ppa]. Only reference visible: Saksena, Baburam 1971 (pp. 3-4).
